children: Pharming Group shares fell in premarket trading Wednesday after it said it paused manufacturing its Ruconest drug  at a contractor's fill-finish facility and that this will likely cause supply interruption to the U.S.
Shares traded 17% lower ahead of the morning bell at $11.02.
The Dutch biotechnology company on Wednesday said it halted production after a routine simulation of the sterile manufacturing process failed.
Current supplies are running low, and the company said that there is only enough inventory available to last through mid-December.
Ruconest treats acute attacks of hereditary angioedema, a rare genetic disorder that causes unpredictable, recurrent episodes of severe swelling in deep body tissues.
Pharming said it has notified the U.S. Food & Drug Administration of the manufacturing pause.
An investigation is underway with no confirmed timeline for restarting production, which will remain offline until the cause is resolved and the manufacturing process is successfully requalified.
